title: Libido (Sex Drive)
summary: Libido is a person's overall interest in sex. It naturally varies between people and over time with stress, sleep, hormones, health, medication, mood and relationship factors.
key_points: There's no 'correct' amount of sex drive.
A sudden or distressing change is worth discussing with a doctor — it can be linked to medication, depression or hormones.
Desire can be spontaneous or appear only after closeness starts (responsive desire).
